subject.title: fix(agents): add lock release timeout on attempt teardown

question: Which retained session lock recovery contract should this PR use when disposal is still not idle after the teardown timeout?
rationale: Timeout-only, force-release, takeover poisoning, and contender-side reclaim have different transcript-concurrency and session-state tradeoffs, and this external PR does not contain owner-approved proof that one contract is safe.

options.title: Require safe recovery before merge
options.body: Ask this PR or a replacement to make the timeout path actually free, poison, or safely reclaim the write lock for the alive same-process failure, with regression coverage and after-fix proof.

options.title: Accept timeout-only as partial mitigation
options.body: Maintainers may intentionally accept teardown liveness improvement while keeping the linked stuck-session issue open for a separate recovery path.

options.title: Consolidate with lock-policy work
options.body: Pause this PR and route the recovery contract through broader retained-lock or maxHold reclaim work if maintainers want one session-lock policy change.

recommendation.title: Require safe recovery before merge
recommendation.body: Ask this PR or a replacement to make the timeout path actually free, poison, or safely reclaim the write lock for the alive same-process failure, with regression coverage and after-fix proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has adjacent session-lock hardening history and was explicitly requested for this PR's recovery decision.
